text:
alisha: Quick heads-up — All-Hands this Wednesday 09:00 PT. We'll do a 45m session: product roadmap + upcoming policy changes + incident learnings + 15m live Q&A. Please drop questions below or use the anonymous form: https://forms.redwood-inference/ah-wed. Recording will be posted after.
marco: Agenda draft: 1) Product roadmap highlights (10m) 2) Dedicated capacity & pricing update (8m) 3) Policy changes: data retention & SSO enforcement (7m) 4) Recent incident recap & mitigations (10m) 5) Q&A (15m). Thoughts?
priya: Can we add a short launch callout for the new quantized model rollout? 2 slides max.
alisha: yes pls add, priya — keep it concise and include rollout guardrails.
sam: We'll include an incident mini-postmortem. I'll drop the timeline slide and next steps.
jen: Heads-up from People Ops: we'll have a 1-min org update about hiring freeze lift — no slides, just 30s.
leo: I'll prepare a 1-slide design demo for the console UX tweaks.
ravi: Legal note: we need to mention the privacy policy updates tied to the retention change. I'll provide the blurb.
priya: Q for leadership: will the SSO enforcement be gradual? impact on self-serve customers?
alisha: Short answer: phased. We'll announce specific tiers and dates during the policy segment.
marco: For Dedicated customers: pricing changes are targeted at new reservations only, existing contracts unaffected. We'll clarify in the slide.
priya: thanks, that helps.
jen: Can we run a quick pre-brief for IC leads 30m before the all-hands to surface any red flags?
alisha: good idea — 08:30 PT pre-brief. I'll send calendar invites.
leo: Emoji reaction: :thumbsup:
priya: question for ops: will the incident recap include follow-up owners? we need clear owners for rollout tasks.
sam: yes — owners + due dates. I'll list them in the slide.
marco: Can folks post any sensitive Qs via the anonymous form. Otherwise tag me for product-specifics.
priya: Posted a question: "Will quantization change inference SLAs for Dedicated customers?"
alisha: We'll answer during the Q&A — probably: no SLA change immediately, but suggested config changes.
alisha: Reminder: submit any slides by Tuesday EOD to the all-hands folder: https://drive.redwood-inference/allhands/wed.
leo: Noted.
--- (post-meeting) ---
townhall-bot: Recording uploaded: https://videos.redwood-inference/ah-1901112222. Transcript available at the same link.
marco: Quick summary/takeaways: 1) Roadmap: focus on latency optimizations and model catalog expansion. 2) Dedicated pricing update applies to new reservations. 3) Policy: data retention window shortened from 90d to 30d for non-enterprise by June 1; SSO enforcement phased starting July 15. 4) Incident recap: root cause was autoscaler bug; mitigations: patch deployed, additional e2e tests, on-call runbook updated. 5) Action items assigned in slide deck.
sam: Incident action items: Sam -> patch monitoring (done), Maya -> verify autoscaler test coverage (due 1901200000), Ops -> schedule follow-up review next week.
ravi: Legal: privacy blurb uploaded to the slide deck and legal FAQ created: https://docs.redwood-inference/legal/privacy-ah.
jen: People Ops follow-up: hiring freeze lift details in the all-hands notes; reach out to me for role prioritization.
priya: Follow-up Q: will there be a public blog post about the policy update? marco?
marco: Yes, comms team will draft a post. Target publish: June 5. We'll circulate the draft to leads.
alisha: Thanks all for quick prep and great discussion. If you had questions that weren't answered, add them here or DM me. :sparkles:
